title: Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion for Feedforward, Locally Trained Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.37047v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a new spiking neural network (SNN) design to process static images and event streams using time-to-first-spike (TTFS) latencies. Our key research question is which architectural choices best accommodate local and online learning in multi-layer convolutional SNNs. This question is addressed via an original framework combining residual-like connections with multi-depth feature aggregation and consensus. The full SNN pipeline features an early-vision front end, to convert raw visual data into sparse spike latencies, a four-layer convolutional backbone trained layerwise with unsupervised spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), a deterministic Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion (MDTF) and a final classifier trained with reward-modulated spike-timing-dependent plasticity (R-STDP). translated_title: 面向前馈、局部训练的脉冲神经网络的多深度时间融合
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新的脉冲神经网络（SNN）设计，利用首次脉冲时间（TTFS）延迟来处理静态图像和事件流。我们的核心研究问题是：在多层卷积SNN中，哪些架构选择最有利于局部和在线学习。该问题通过一个原创框架得到解决，该框架将类残差连接与多深度特征聚合和共识机制相结合。完整的SNN流程包括：一个早期视觉前端，用于将原始视觉数据转换为稀疏的脉冲延迟；一个四层卷积主干网络，采用无监督的脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP）逐层训练；一个确定性的多深度时间融合（MDTF）模块；以及一个最终分类器，采用奖励调制的脉冲时序依赖可塑性（R-STDP）进行训练。与在更深层中替换早期特征的做法不同，所提出的MDTF保留了早期的时间证据，并添加来自中间层的稀疏残差事件……
tldr: 该论文提出一种多深度时间融合（MDTF）框架，将类残差连接与多深度特征聚合相结合，使完全依靠局部STDP/R-STDP在线学习的前馈脉冲神经网络能够有效处理静态图像和事件流。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion (MDTF) framework that combines residual-like connections with multi-depth feature aggregation, enabling feedforward spiking neural networks trained entirely with local STDP/R-STDP rules to effectively process static images and event streams.
